title: Complete Your First Task
description: Prove your worth to the System by completing a daily goal.
story: The System has awakened within you. A faint blue glow surrounds your vision as a notification appears before your eyes. 'Complete Your First Task' — the message reads in glowing cyan letters. This is your first step into a world you barely understand. The System has chosen you, and only through perseverance will you unlock its true potential. Your hands tremble slightly as you realize this is no dream. The adventurers around you speak of dungeons and monsters, of power and death. Today, you take your first step. Complete this simple goal to prove you are worthy of the power that has been bestowed upon you. The System does not guide the weak — it destroys them.
